LSJ~

I'm sure that this question has already been asked before, but -

Gargoyle is in combat with Poor Toreador With no Majesty.
Gargoyle is the acting minion.
As his strike, Gargoyle plays Pounce, dealing Str+2 damage, and denying the
PTWNM his strike (does not affect current strike resolution).

Does that mean that PTWNM does not get a strike this round, or is it just
some wierd corner case situation when the Gargoyle has first strike that the
strike denial comes in?

~Shankar Gupta
Prince of New York

the latter.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. It also keeps the PTWNM from using any additional strikes he
may have during that round (a more likely scenario than the Gargoyle
gaining First Strike).
